title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 27 September 2026
description: Today: a striking new sculpture honours children's author Andy Griffiths; the combined Queensland Heartland bid emerges as a contender for the NRL's 20th licence; and the Gold Coast Titans face Brisbane in today's NRLW preliminary final at Cbus Super Stadium. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
